pixel_heart.description: A pixel-art heart extruded into a field of small 3D cubes on a single MultiMesh (one draw call). The 'love' reaction in the project's own cube vocabulary — warm red voxels, beveled, readable across a room.
pixel_heart.name: Pixel Heart
pixel_heart.qfep_connection: A reaction is a primitive feeling, so it is a primitive object — the heart was always pixels; we gave the pixels depth.

pixel_thumb.description: A pixel-art thumbs-up extruded into a field of small 3D cubes on a single MultiMesh (one draw call). The 'friend / approved' reaction in the project's own cube vocabulary — cool blue voxels, beveled.
pixel_thumb.name: Pixel Thumb
pixel_thumb.qfep_connection: The thumb says yes in the grammar of the grid — the catalyst's foe-to-friend arc made into a solid object.

floating_sphere_field.description: A sparse field of soft glowing spheres drifting in the void on a single GPUParticles3D. The subtle successor to the Kusama dot-grid biome layer — presence-by-scarcity instead of overwhelming repetition. Ambient atmosphere for the void around the player.
floating_sphere_field.name: Floating Sphere Field
floating_sphere_field.qfep_connection: The void was never empty, only under-rendered. Replacing the lattice with a drift trades the comfort of fixed coordinates for the truth that presence does not require a position — the F term loosening before λE(S).

xyz_slider_plate.description: Dieter Rams plate with three sliders (X, Y, Z) that move a glowing point through space. Live coordinate display and line to origin. Teaches axis independence — moving one slider doesn't affect the others.
xyz_slider_plate.name: XYZ Slider Plate
xyz_slider_plate.qfep_connection: Axis independence as felt experience — the hand learns that three degrees of freedom are orthogonal by moving each one alone.

laser_sword.description: Grabbable glowing blade on a Rams handle — pick it up and the blade ignites with a layered hum. Swing speed modulates pitch and glow intensity. Teaches directed line segment as embodied intention.
laser_sword.name: Laser Sword
laser_sword.qfep_connection: Direction as embodied will — the blade points where you point, making directed line segment a felt experience before a mathematical concept.

grabbable_line.description: A line segment you grab as one object — pick up anywhere along its length to move it through space. Fixed length, visible endpoints, integer-resistance glitch. Complements the endpoint-first line by teaching whole-before-parts.
grabbable_line.name: Grabbable Line
grabbable_line.qfep_connection: Holding a line whole before decomposing it into endpoints — unity precedes analysis, the body grasps the relation before the mind names the parts.

code_evolution_screen.description: Dual-panel VR code viewer — watch code build up stage by stage with parallel thinking narration. Uses SubViewport + RichTextLabel with Catppuccin Mocha syntax highlighting.
code_evolution_screen.name: Code Evolution Screen
code_evolution_screen.qfep_connection: Code as temporal process — each line is a decision, each stage is a conceptual leap. Understanding emerges from watching construction, not reading completion.

PipeLayout.description: High-level pipe network controller with anchor points. Supports glass and drain pipe types. Use PipeLayout#layout:network_name or PipeLayout#pipe_type:glass
PipeLayout.name: PipeLayout

aalto_vase.description: Procedural Aalto-style organic vase using Fourier harmonics. Based on Alvar Aalto's Savoy vase (1936).
aalto_vase.name: aalto_vase
aalto_vase.qfep_connection: Flatten the harmonics array to [1.0] and the Savoy silhouette relapses into a plain cylinder; the whole icon lives in three extra cosine coefficients. Authorship survives as a vector short enough to memorize — modernism signed in four floats.

alessi_tree.description: Procedural Alessi-style stacked cone tree with radial stripes. Zigzag lathe form.
alessi_tree.name: alessi_tree

animated_cube.description: Cartesian coordinate system, x y z godot
animated_cube.name: Animated Cube

animatedcubebuilder.description: Animated construction sequence that steps from vertices to edges to full cube mesh with grab handles.
animatedcubebuilder.name: animatedcubebuilder
animatedcubebuilder.qfep_connection: The cube assembled in slow motion — vertices, then edges, then faces, with grab handles at each stage. The chapter's core sentence played as animation: everything from nothing, watched happening, the eight corners of the grid's own unit born one construction step at a time.

arch.description: Architectural arch with curved top and pillars
arch.name: Arch

array_rotate.description: Array + Rotate. rotation[i] = i Ã— angle. The fan/wheel: cumulative rotation around axis.
array_rotate.name: array_rotate

array_scale.description: Array + Scale. scale[i] = factor^i. The nest: cumulative scaling (telescoping).
array_scale.name: array_scale

array_translate.description: Array + Translate. position[i] = i Ã— offset. The staircase: cumulative translation.
array_translate.name: array_translate

array_visualizer.description: Interactive tool for visualizing array structures
array_visualizer.name: Array Visualizer

bigframe.description: Hollow rectangular beam with configurable dimensions
bigframe.name: bigframe
bigframe.qfep_connection: A hollow rectangular beam — the quad given thickness and a window. The primitive becoming architecture: a frame is a shape that has decided what to leave out, enclosure defined by its hole.

bipyramid.description: Double-ended pyramid primitive formed by mirrored pyramid faces.
bipyramid.name: bipyramid

bucket_of_tulips.description: A charming metal bucket filled with colorful tulips, bringing natural beauty and algorithmic growth patterns to the laboratory space
bucket_of_tulips.name: Bucket of Tulips

capsule.description: Grid-shaded capsule primitive with glowing wireframe overlay.
capsule.name: capsule
capsule.qfep_connection: A cylinder that rounded its ends — the primitive of the *organic*, the shape a body or a pill takes when it refuses corners. Grid-shaded with a glowing wireframe, it holds both codes at once: the lattice underneath, the smoothness on top.

capsule_radials_rings.description: Configurable capsule with radial segments and rings. Usage: capsule_radials_rings:90:1:#radial:6#rings:3 for 6 radial segments and 3 rings.
capsule_radials_rings.name: Capsule Radials Rings
capsule_radials_rings.qfep_connection: The capsule with its resolution exposed — radial segments and rings you can set. The reminder that every smooth thing here is secretly faceted, curvature a lie told convincingly by enough flat pieces. Turn the dial down and the body becomes a barrel.

chaos_attractor.description: Visualization of chaotic systems and strange attractors
chaos_attractor.name: Chaos Attractor
chaos_attractor.qfep_connection: lambda_edge: strange attractors traced live — deterministic rules whose futures diverge from any measurable present. The room where F = ma stops promising prediction.

combine_capsule.description: Arranges capsule meshes in a matrix while iterating through height and radial segment combinations.
combine_capsule.name: combine_capsule
combine_capsule.qfep_connection: Height stretches the middle while segments sharpen the skin: one axis measures the world, the other measures how coarsely you agreed to describe it. The sweep lays both kinds of number side by side and lets neither pretend to be the other.

combine_portals.description: Duplicates a base torus to form a tunnel of portals that grow denser down the hallway.
combine_portals.name: combine_portals
combine_portals.qfep_connection: One torus duplicated down a hall, denser as it recedes — the primitive caught in the act of becoming a corridor. Repetition with a gradient: how a single ring, told to multiply toward a vanishing point, manufactures depth out of nothing but its own copies.

combine_primitives.description: Shows four procedural walled-cube modules (cylinder, plane, sphere, torus) side by side for layout inspection.
combine_primitives.name: combine_primitives

combine_sphere.description: Builds a grid of spheres varying ring and radial segment settings with optional hemisphere alternation.
combine_sphere.name: combine_sphere
combine_sphere.qfep_connection: A walkable table of one decision: every rings-by-segments pair gets its own labelled ball, the coarse ones reading as faceted gems, the fine ones as smooth. A sphere shown to be a resolution you choose with your eyes.

combine_torus.description: Generates a gradient-colored grid of torus meshes sweeping through ring and segment counts.
combine_torus.name: combine_torus

combo_cube_visual.description: A visual-only cube that moves, rotates, and scales simultaneously (Not a pickup).
combo_cube_visual.name: Transformation Rotation Scale Cube

concept_synthesizer.description: Device for synthesizing abstract concepts into tangible forms
concept_synthesizer.name: Concept Synthesizer

coordinate_axes_xy.description: Displays orthogonal X/Y line modules with floating labels for quick planar orientation.
coordinate_axes_xy.name: coordinate_axes_xy

coordinate_lines.description: Orthogonal vertical and horizontal line modules forming a coordinate axis crosshair.
coordinate_lines.name: coordinate_lines

cross_line_puzzle.description: Interactive puzzle: drag line endpoints to form an X cross from two horizontal lines. Tag syntax: cross_line_puzzle:rot:ytrans:scale#tagname:action (e.g., cross_line_puzzle:0:0:1#fillhole:reveal triggers 'reveal' action on all nodes tagged 'fillhole' when solved)
cross_line_puzzle.name: Cross Line Puzzle
cross_line_puzzle.qfep_connection: Two draggable lines, four shared snap targets, and a solution accepted only when the constraints PERPENDICULAR and INTERSECT_CENTER both hold: the X is not a picture to copy but a predicate to satisfy, and satisfying it can fire actions on any node tagged to listen.

cross_lines.description: Pair of line modules rotated into an X to demonstrate intersecting lines.
cross_lines.name: cross_lines

crystal.description: Procedurally built quartz-style crystal with layered facets.
crystal.name: crystal

crystalcluster.description: Cluster of scaled crystals arranged with deterministic offsets.
crystalcluster.name: crystalcluster

cube.description: Static cube with grid shader and collider, used as a baseline geometric primitive.
cube.name: cube
cube.qfep_connection: Half-edge 0.5, so the default body is exactly one grid cell: the primitive and the system that places it agree on a unit, and apply_grid_config is the amendment clause of that treaty.

cube_lines.name: cube_lines
cube_lines.qfep_connection: Twelve thin lines and no faces: the cube reduced to its adjacency, an inventory of edges showing the volume was always an inference the eye supplies.

cube_projectile_spawner.description: Timed hazard that spawns projectile cubes, leads the target, and fires warning effects before launch.
cube_projectile_spawner.name: cube_projectile_spawner
cube_projectile_spawner.qfep_connection: It does not shoot at you, it shoots at where its model says you will be: target_prediction leads the player's velocity before every launch. Being hunted here means being forecast, with the warning glow as the only courtesy.

cube_scene.capacity: TEST how cubes can split, snap, scale, and recombine while remaining the basic reference primitive.
cube_scene.description: A configurable cube scene used as reference geometry across the project. Its variants can be grabbed, scaled, subdivided, snapped, or augmented, but the cube remains the stable primitive beneath those state changes. That makes it ideal for seeing what a transformation preserves and what it alters. In the transformation sequence it functions as the baseline form against which other changes read clearly.
interactions: grab cube variants and move them through space
compare scaled, subdivided, and snapped cube behaviors
attach or detach auxiliary utilities where present
use the cube as a baseline reference for other transformed forms
cube_scene.name: Basic Cube Scene
cube_scene.qfep_connection: Transformation changes S while the cube serves as the invariant reference body. Because the base form is so legible, every modification becomes easy to compare against it.

cube_scene_drag_points.name: cube_scene_drag_points
cube_scene_drag_points.qfep_connection: Eight grab spheres, one per corner, and the cube turns out to be a treaty among vertices: drag one and the faces re-triangulate around your decision. Rigidity revealed as a default, not a property.

cube_with_shader.description: Cartesian coordinate system, x y z godot
cube_with_shader.name: Cube with shader

cylinder.description: Basic grid-lined cylinder primitive for quick scale checks.
cylinder.name: cylinder

cylinder_low.description: Low poly cylinder with 8 radial segments showing faceted structure.
cylinder_low.name: cylinder_low

cylinder_mid.description: Medium poly cylinder with 16 radial segments for smooth curves.
cylinder_mid.name: cylinder_mid

cylinder_radials_rings.description: Configurable cylinder with radial segments and rings. Usage: cylinder_radials_rings:90:1:#config:12:8 for 12 radial segments and 8 rings.
cylinder_radials_rings.name: Cylinder Radials Rings

dgrid.description: Standing perspective grid frame inspired by Albrecht DÃ¼rer. Use dgrid:90:1:1#config:10:10 for 10x10 grid.
dgrid.name: DÃ¼rer Grid
dgrid.qfep_connection: Dürer's perspective frame standing in the room — the drafting instrument that taught the Renaissance to project three dimensions onto two. The primitive of *seeing*: before you can build space you must agree how to depict it, and this grid is that agreement made in wood.

diamond.description: Faceted diamond mesh generated with grid shading for highlights.
diamond.name: diamond

diamonds.description: Stacks rotating octahedron instances into a twisting diamond tower sculpture.
diamonds.name: diamonds
diamonds.qfep_connection: Octahedra stacked and rotated into a twisting tower — the single primitive multiplied into sculpture. The chapter's quiet thesis made ornamental: give one regular solid a rule for repeating and it grows a spire nobody carved.

dodecahedron.description: Procedural dodecahedron solid using grid material.
dodecahedron.name: dodecahedron

dome.description: Half-sphere primitive produced by boolean subtraction — used as reference geometry for enclosures and shelters.
dome.name: dome
dome.qfep_connection: A half-sphere cut from a solid by boolean subtraction — reference geometry for enclosure, the simplest roof. In the procedural rooms it stands as the authored control against which the grown forms are measured: this is what shape looks like when someone *drew* it, so you can feel how different the grown ones are.

doublestick.name: doublestick
doublestick.qfep_connection: A line that exists only as a relation: the cylinder is rebuilt sixty times a second between ForceOne and ForceTwo, and moving either endpoint redraws the connection. The segment owns no position of its own.

draw_dot.description: sample(hand_position) → ImmediateMesh trail — the hand writes points in 3D space
draw_dot.name: draw_dot
draw_dot.qfep_connection: The hand becomes an instrument that leaves evidence: sampled positions accumulate into a trail, and six meters of accrued drawing throws the unlock. A curve confessed as dense point samples, with a door listening to how far you have moved.

draw_dot_time_domain.description: Draw dot with time-domain trace along +Z.
draw_dot_time_domain.name: draw_dot_time_domain
draw_dot_time_domain.qfep_connection: oscillation: a dot that draws its own history — motion smeared into a time-domain trace; the simplest possible oscilloscope.

draw_triangle_faces.description: fan_triangulate(loop) → colored mesh face — closed point loops become surfaces
draw_triangle_faces.name: draw_triangle_faces
draw_triangle_faces.qfep_connection: fan_triangulate(loop) → a colored surface: the moment a closed loop of points stops being an outline and becomes a face you could stand on. The bridge from edge to skin — how everything solid in this project is, underneath, triangles agreeing to be a plane.

dynamic_rock.description: Single procedural rock with gravity enabled - falls naturally with physics
dynamic_rock.name: Dynamic Rock

editable_bezier.description: Cubic Bezier curve editor. 4 control points: P0-P1 defines start tangent, P2-P3 defines end tangent. Shows tangent handles.
editable_bezier.name: editable_bezier

editable_catmull_rom.description: Catmull-Rom spline editor. Curve passes through all control points. More intuitive for freeform drawing.
editable_catmull_rom.name: editable_catmull_rom

editable_curve.description: Interactive curve with grabbable control points. Supports Bezier, Catmull-Rom, and linear modes. Extends the trace concept: deliberate construction over recorded gesture.
editable_curve.name: editable_curve

elevator_platform.description: Platform that slides up/down on Y axis. Teaches vertical translation with grid snapping to floor levels.
elevator_platform.name: Elevator Platform

falling_cube.description: Simple falling cube for physics testing
falling_cube.name: Falling Cube

folded_strip.description: triangle_strip(24) — alternating-height vertices forming a pleated ribbon of connected faces
folded_strip.name: 1.2: folded_strip
folded_strip.qfep_connection: triangle_strip(24) — a pleated ribbon of alternating heights, faces sharing edges down its length. The most economical surface in the project: maximum face from minimum vertex, the primitive of the fold that the softbody and creature chapters will later make move.

foldedpaper.description: Accordion-style folded paper mesh with editable top/base control points and multiple fold reset modes.
foldedpaper.name: 1.2: A foldedpaper

folding_cube.description: Animated cube net folding into 3D cube. Shows how 6 connected squares become a volume. Cross net with hinge animation.
folding_cube.name: folding_cube

folding_cube_interactive.description: Interactive folding cube. Grab the handle to manually fold/unfold. Snaps to flat or folded state on release.
folding_cube_interactive.name: folding_cube_interactive

folding_past.description: Animated accordion fold representing time/the past collapsing into the present.
folding_past.name: Folding Past
folding_past.qfep_connection: An accordion collapsing — time made geometric, the past pleating into the present. The one primitive here that is a *metaphor* on purpose: folding as memory, the chapter admitting that even its cleanest shapes carry meaning they didn't ask for.

geometric_crystal.description: A crystal that contains spatial algorithms
geometric_crystal.name: Geometric Crystal

glass_planes_2_5d.description: 2.5D: Glass planes + noise. Discrete layers framing continuous field. Volumetric look, flat render cost.
glass_planes_2_5d.name: glass_planes_2_5d

glass_planes_empty.description: 2.5D: Array of transparent glass planes. Pure repetition â€” depth from layered transparency. No noise.
glass_planes_empty.name: glass_planes_empty

grab_aalto_vase.description: Grabbable Aalto vase. Procedural organic form with glass material.
grab_aalto_vase.name: grab_aalto_vase

grab_alessi_tree.description: Grabbable Alessi tree. Red and white striped ceramic-style holiday decoration.
grab_alessi_tree.name: grab_alessi_tree

grab_dodecahedron.description: Grabbable dodecahedron. 12 pentagonal faces, 20 vertices, 30 edges.
grab_dodecahedron.name: grab_dodecahedron

grab_icosahedron.description: Grabbable icosahedron. 20 triangular faces, 12 vertices, 30 edges.
grab_icosahedron.name: grab_icosahedron

grab_line.description: Adjustable length grabbable line with trigger+joystick length control and optional length display.
grab_line.name: grab_line

grab_line_drawer.description: Grabbable line that draws fading trails from the tip when trigger is held.
grab_line_drawer.name: grab_line_drawer

grab_line_music.description: Grabbable line that produces music based on movement speed and length, with selectable waveforms.
grab_line_music.name: grab_line_music

grab_line_pusher.description: Grabbable line with sphere collider at tip for pushing objects away.
grab_line_pusher.name: grab_line_pusher

grab_long_stick.name: grab_long_stick
grab_long_stick.qfep_connection: F_force: the probe — a graspable stick trailing a long cloth ribbon. It is how the hand asks a soft world questions: poke, drag, sweep, and the ribbon writes the answer in folds. The instrument of contact in the softbodies rooms; force made holdable.

grab_octahedron.description: octahedron — 6 vertices, 12 edges, 8 triangular faces: dual of the cube, Platonic solid
grab_octahedron.name: grab_octahedron
grab_octahedron.qfep_connection: Six vertices, eight faces — the cube's dual, the solid you get by putting a point on each of the cube's faces. Grabbable proof that the Platonic solids come in pairs that trade places, symmetry hiding inside symmetry.

grab_rainbow_stick.name: grab_rainbow_stick
grab_rainbow_stick.qfep_connection: the rainbow made holdable — a spectrum along a stick; the gradient as a hand tool.

grab_sphere_point.description: XR Tools pickable sphere with highlight ring for repositioning a reference point.
grab_sphere_point.name: grab_sphere_point
grab_sphere_point.qfep_connection: a pickable reference point — the hand's handle on the diagram; it marks where the question is asked, never dominant in the room.

grab_sphere_point_color_with_text.description: Pickable point sphere combining color tint control with a live coordinate label.
grab_sphere_point_color_with_text.name: grab_sphere_point_color_with_text

grab_sphere_point_snap.description: snap(position) = round(position / grid_size) * grid_size — discretise continuous space
grab_sphere_point_snap.name: grab_sphere_point_snap
grab_sphere_point_snap.qfep_connection: Your analog hand against round(position / grid_size): the sphere follows you continuously, then clicks to the nearest lattice point, and the trail records which differences survived. Quantization felt as a series of small verdicts on your movement.

grab_sphere_point_with_color.description: Pickable point sphere that applies emission-tinted colors via the point_color helper.
grab_sphere_point_with_color.name: grab_sphere_point_with_color_text

grab_sphere_point_with_text.description: Pickable point sphere preset with a floating Label3D that shows its coordinates.
grab_sphere_point_with_text.name: grab_sphere_point_with_text

grab_trihedron.description: trihedron — 4 vertices, 3 triangular faces and 1 quad base: the wedge as 3D primitive
grab_trihedron.name: grab_trihedron
grab_trihedron.qfep_connection: The wedge as 3D primitive — 4 vertices, three triangular faces on a quad base. The catalyst bracelet's walkable prism in its pure geometric form: the smallest solid that can also be a ramp, where primitive meets architecture.

grid_lines.description: grid = {x=i*step, z=j*step : i,j ∈ ℤ} — the XZ plane made legible as a lattice of lines
grid_lines.name: grid_lines
grid_lines.qfep_connection: The lattice claims to be reference, then quietly becomes a stage: saved player traces land on its intersections as scaled, rotating meshes, replaying movement as spatial memory. A coordinate system that ends up exhibiting the bodies that used it.

halocube.description: Hollow cube frame with four mitered walls
halocube.name: Halo Cube

hole_with_cones.description: Ground plane with circular hole and 3 traffic cones around it. Construction site warning setup.
hole_with_cones.name: Hole With Cones
hole_with_cones.qfep_connection: A ground plane with a circular hole and three warning cones — the negative primitive, a shape defined by its absence. Construction-site vernacular making the point the origin couldn't: that a void is also a form, and that the floor of this world can be told to *not* be there.

hollowrock.description: Hollow rock using torus with varied openings
hollowrock.name: Hollow Rock

icosahedron.description: Procedural icosahedron primitive for sphere approximations.
icosahedron.name: icosahedron
icosahedron.qfep_connection: Three orthogonal golden rectangles pinned at their corners — the roundest the Platonic family ever gets, and it gets there by leaning on an irrational number it can never fully spend.

interactive_point_origin_force.description: Force-catalyst variant of interactive_point_origin. Starts as a plain point; on pickup a vertex shader morphs the surface into a pulsing 'force field' shell. While held with the morph engaged, nearby RigidBody3D objects feel an inverse-square pull toward the artifact. With both hands closed (the OrbGestureDetector two-hand gesture), the artifact spits a luminous projectile ball forward.
interactive_point_origin_force.name: 1.0.2 Interactive Point — Force Catalyst

parameters.attraction_radius: Sphere radius (m) within which RigidBody3D bodies feel the pull. Default 1.5.
parameters.attraction_strength: Pull-force coefficient k in F = k / d². Default 8.0.
parameters.ball_speed: Initial velocity (m/s) of two-hand projectile balls. Default 6.0.
parameters.ball_lifetime: How long each spawned ball lives before queue_free. Default 2.0s.
parameters.morph_speed: How fast morph_t lerps from 0 → 1 on pickup. Default 1.4 (≈0.7s).

interactive_point_origin_force.qfep_connection: F_force: the origin point that becomes a force field in the hand — picked up, its surface morphs to a pulsing shell that pushes nearby bodies. The coordinate origin revealed as an actor, not an address.

interactive_point_origin.description: Pickable point that displays its position and draws a thin line to origin (0,0,0) when held.
interactive_point_origin.name: 1.0.1 Interactive Point with Origin Line
interactive_point_origin.qfep_connection: Every position is a debt to (0,0,0): lift the point and a thin line names its creditor, while each pickup cycles the coordinate through four notations — the number never changes, only its costume.

interactivetriangle.description: Standing triangle panel split into pink and black faces with grab spheres and multiple shape resets.
interactivetriangle.name: 1.2: A triangle
interactivetriangle.qfep_connection: The triangle as a panel you argue with — pink and black faces, grab spheres, presets to snap between shapes. The subject made operable: not a triangle shown but a triangle *handled*, its three-ness confirmed by your own hands moving the corners.

knowledge_prism.description: Prism that refracts complex concepts into understandable forms
knowledge_prism.name: Knowledge Prism

laser_measure.description: Handheld laser distance measurement tool with LCD display
laser_measure.name: laser_measure
laser_measure.qfep_connection: The handheld ruler with an LCD conscience: point, and the world answers in meters. Measurement as a portable act — the abstraction of the line turned into a tool you carry, distance no longer a property of two points but a question you can ask anywhere.

lefttriangle.description: Complementary right-triangle prism leaning left, rendered with pink grid shading and configurable size.
lefttriangle.name: lefttriangle

level_entrance.description: Entrance tile with door frame and label text
level_entrance.name: Level Entrance

light_sphere.name: light_sphere
light_sphere.qfep_connection: A forty-meter mirrored sphere occupied from the inside, reflection probe and omni light included: not an object in the room but the lighting condition the rest of the room is seen under.

lightrod.description: Glowing vertical blue light rods. Use lightrod:90:0:1#config:4:1 for 4 rods with 1m spacing.
lightrod.name: Light Rod
lightrod.qfep_connection: Glowing verticals at set spacing — the line standing up and repeating. Rhythm from the simplest rule: same element, even interval. The primitive learning that pattern is just a primitive plus a beat.

line.description: Interactive measuring line linking two grab spheres and rendering a cylinder with live distance text.
line.name: 1.1 A Line
line.qfep_connection: Two points consent to a relationship and a line is born, its length live between them. The primitive after the point, and the first thing in the project with an *inside* — a here-to-there. Distance made grabbable: measurement as the second thing that exists.

line_collection.description: Bundle of line modules offset in space for demonstrations of multiple edges.
line_collection.name: line_collection

line_demo.description: snap_connection(pointA, pointB) → line — demonstrate the SnapConnectionManager wiring
line_demo.name: line_demo

lshape.description: Upside down L shape primitive with meeting corner joints
lshape.name: L Shape
lshape.qfep_connection: An upside-down L, two beams meeting at a corner joint — the first primitive that is *assembled* rather than born, a shape made of shapes. Where the alphabet starts spelling.

mengersponge.description: Menger sponge fractal with configurable depth
mengersponge.name: Menger Sponge

menu.description: Stacked slanted-cube VR menu with animated hover, keyboard navigation, and theme switching.
menu.name: menu

modernchair.description: Modern chair with configurable seat, legs and backrest
modernchair.name: Modern Chair

modernpolysolid.description: Twisted multi-level polysolid sculpture with pride-inspired materials.
modernpolysolid.name: modernpolysolid

noisetorus_ex_1.description: Example torus mesh using the noise planet shader to showcase parameter tweaks.
noisetorus_ex_1.name: noisetorus_ex_1

octahedron.description: Procedural octahedron primitive useful as a diamond core.
octahedron.name: octahedron
octahedron.qfep_connection: Six vertices are the coordinate axes made solid — hold it and you hold plus and minus x, y, z — while the cube waits inside its face centers for the dual swap.

origin.description: (0, 0, 0) — the reference from which all coordinates are measured
origin.name: Point Zero
origin.qfep_connection: (0,0,0) — the reference from which all coordinates are measured, and the chapter's true first artifact. Everything in this project has an address because this point agreed to be zero. A decision disguised as a fact: someone had to choose where nothing begins.

oscillation_cube.description: A cube that demonstrates smooth oscillating motion along multiple axes
oscillation_cube.name: Oscillation Cube

parallel_line_puzzle.description: Interactive puzzle: drag line endpoints to align two lines to be parallel.
parallel_line_puzzle.name: Parallel Line Puzzle
parallel_line_puzzle.qfep_connection: Drag two lines until they will never meet. The puzzle makes 'parallel' a thing your hands discover rather than a word you're told — and quietly seeds the crisis chapter, where the promise these lines keep turns out to have been a choice all along.

parallel_lines.description: Three line modules arranged in parallel to visualize equidistant lines.
parallel_lines.name: parallel_lines
parallel_lines.qfep_connection: f_order: three lines holding their distance forever — Euclid's fifth postulate standing in the room as furniture, so ordinary that its overthrow next door lands as vertigo.

parametric_surface.name: Parametric Surface
parametric_surface.qfep_connection: Two variables in, one twisted shell out: the whole form hangs on cos(v)(1+cos u)sin(v/8), and moving v_max decides how much of the shape is permitted to exist.

perspective_lines.description: all lines → (0,0,0) — convergence to a single vanishing point as perspective law
perspective_lines.name: perspective_lines
perspective_lines.qfep_connection: All lines running to one point — the vanishing point, perspective's single law. The Renaissance's most consequential primitive: the discovery that depth on a flat surface is just convergence, that space can be faked by a ruler aimed at infinity. The line taught to lie about distance, and the whole illusion of the third dimension riding on that one honest trick.

pickup_cube_combo.description: A pickup cube that moves, rotates, and scales simultaneously.
pickup_cube_combo.name: Combo Pickup Cube

pickup_cube_rotating.description: Pickup cube that rotates continuously — wraps pick_up_cube.gd and disables internal collision so the player can walk into the pickup area freely.
pickup_cube_rotating.name: Rotating Pickup Cube
pickup_cube_rotating.qfep_connection: oscillation: a pickup cube in rotation — periodic motion in the hand; frequency you can grip.

pickup_cube_scaling.description: A pickup cube that pulsates in size.
pickup_cube_scaling.name: Scaling Pickup Cube

pickup_cube_static.description: A static pickup cube that can be collected.
pickup_cube_static.name: Static Pickup Cube
pickup_cube_static.qfep_connection: a pickup cube, still — the baseline state; hold it to feel zero oscillation.

pickup_cube_transforming.description: A pickup cube that moves up and down.
pickup_cube_transforming.name: Transforming Pickup Cube
pickup_cube_transforming.qfep_connection: a pickup cube mid-transformation — states cycling; change as the held constant.

plane.description: Grid-shaded plane mesh (0.8m square) used for flat surface demonstrations.
plane.name: plane

platonic_demo.name: platonic_demo
platonic_demo.qfep_connection: A finite family passed hand to hand: the five closed solids share a shelf with a grab-trihedron that geometry refuses to close, and the snap code treats the legitimate and the impossible exactly alike.

platonic_grabbables.description: Compact table of all 5 platonic solids, 3 grabbable copies each. Tetrahedron, cube, octahedron, dodecahedron, icosahedron.
platonic_grabbables.name: platonic_grabbables
platonic_grabbables.qfep_connection: All five Platonic solids on one table, three grabbable copies each — the complete set of perfectly regular volumes, which antiquity thought were the elements themselves. Pick them up and hold the fact Plato held: there are exactly five, and no more are possible, a scarcity built into space.

player_trace.capacity: SEE your own motion become a drawable path through time.
player_trace.description: A recorder that turns the player's motion into a visible line in space. Every step writes another point, so translation through the room becomes geometry rather than a forgotten action. The artifact makes path and trajectory tangible, especially when compared against grids and axis-constrained motion. It turns movement into a time-indexed drawing.
interactions: walk through space to extend the trace
change trail_length to keep more or less motion history
compare your recorded path against grid or axis demonstrations
use the line as a visible record of translation over time
player_trace.name: player_trace
player_trace.qfep_connection: Transformation is recorded here as a trajectory through S over time. The body changes position continuously, while the trace preserves that history as form.

plus.description: Plus/cross shape (+) with 4 arms at 90 degree angles. Classic health pickup shape.
plus.name: Plus
plus.qfep_connection: Four arms at right angles — the cross, and every player's memory of a health pickup. Symmetry at its most legible: rotate it a quarter turn and nothing changes, the primitive that teaches invariance before the symmetry chapter names it.

plus_line_puzzle.description: Interactive puzzle: drag line endpoints to form a + (plus) with perpendicular lines.
plus_line_puzzle.name: Plus Line Puzzle
plus_line_puzzle.qfep_connection: Drag the endpoints until two lines cross at right angles — a plus, a cross, the first perpendicular. The puzzle where the hand discovers orthogonality: that 90 degrees is not given but *made*, a relation you can satisfy or miss, and the quiet foundation of every grid this world is built on.

plus_lines.description: Reusable plus-shaped line rig built from two line segments for crosshair highlights.
plus_lines.name: plus_lines

point.description: Pickable point sphere that continuously displays its world coordinates with a floating label.
point.name: 1.0 A Point
point.qfep_connection: A grabbable nothing that answers with three numbers: move the sphere and the label re-reports (x, y, z) every frame. Location shown as an address rather than a thing, and the whole primitives sequence grows from that admission.

point_collection.description: Grouped set of labelled pickable points for demonstrating multiple coordinate references.
point_collection.name: point_collection

portal_frame.description: Portal doorway frame with three-plate lintel
portal_frame.name: Portal Frame

prism.description: Grid-shaded triangular prism mesh for primitive previews.
prism.name: prism

prism_block.capacity: COMPARE how a non-cubic primitive responds to rotation and scaling.
prism_block.description: A triangular prism used as reference geometry when cubes are too symmetrical to show the difference clearly. Rotating or scaling it changes which faces dominate the view, so the artifact makes orientation and aspect easier to read. It is a reminder that transformations act on more than boxes. The prism broadens the learner's sense of what can stay invariant under change.
interactions: place the prism beside cubes as a comparison shape
inspect how triangular faces reorient under rotation
use the block as a reference for scaling exercises
compare its silhouette against more symmetric primitives
prism_block.name: prism_block
prism_block.qfep_connection: Transformation changes pose and size while the prism's edge structure stays coherent. A less symmetric primitive makes preserved relations easier to notice.

prismblock.description: Triangular wedge primitive with grid shader and convex collision.
prismblock.name: prismblock

probability_sphere.description: A sphere that shows the dance of randomness
probability_sphere.name: Probability Sphere

proceduralrock.description: Procedural rock using icosphere and noise deformation
proceduralrock.name: Procedural Rock

profile_chair.description: Profile chair with integrated seat and backrest corners
profile_chair.name: Profile Chair

pyramid.description: Procedural square-based pyramid primitive built via surface tool.
pyramid.name: pyramid
pyramid.qfep_connection: The square base lifts to a point and the plane becomes a volume — the first primitive with a *height*, built face by face from the surface tool. Position, then line, then face, then this: the fourth step, where flat space finally admits it was hiding a third direction.

pyramid_edit.description: Interactive pyramid demo with grab handles to reshape the base and apex.
pyramid_edit.name: pyramid_edit
pyramid_edit.qfep_connection: The pyramid with handles: reshape the base, drag the apex, watch the volume answer. Solid geometry made clay — the subject confirmed by deformation, the walker learning a shape by breaking and remaking it.

pyramidlong.description: Procedurally models a long rectangular pyramid primitive with computed faces and materials.
pyramidlong.name: pyramidlong
pyramidlong.qfep_connection: A long rectangular pyramid, faces and materials computed on the fly — the pyramid stretched until it becomes a wedge, a roof, a prow. Proof that the primitives are a *family* of proportions, not a fixed set of nouns.

pythagorean_proof.description: Interactive right-triangle construction with draggable vertices and animated area proof squares.
pythagorean_proof.name: pythagorean_proof

pythagorean_triangle_angles.description: a² + b² = c² — the Pythagorean theorem made spatial: three squares grown from triangle sides
pythagorean_triangle_angles.name: 1.2: A pythagorean_triangle_angles
pythagorean_triangle_angles.qfep_connection: a² + b² = c², grown as three real squares from a triangle's sides so the theorem stops being algebra and becomes area you can see balance. The oldest proof in the building, made spatial — measurement's first law standing in the room as furniture.

quad.description: Editable quad divided into pink and black triangles with draggable corners and square/rectangle/diamond presets.
quad.name: quad
quad.qfep_connection: Four corners, two triangles wearing one skin — the quad is the triangle's compromise with convenience, the face that tiles a wall. Split into pink and black it shows its seam honestly: every rectangle in this world is two triangles keeping a secret.

quad_line_puzzle.description: Interactive puzzle: drag 4 line endpoints to form a square.
quad_line_puzzle.name: Quad Line Puzzle
quad_line_puzzle.qfep_connection: Drag four endpoints until they close into a square. The puzzle where lines learn to become an enclosure — the hand discovering that four right angles is a *condition*, not a given, and that a shape is a set of relationships you can satisfy or break.

quantum_dice.description: Dice that demonstrate quantum probability principles
quantum_dice.name: Quantum Dice

queer_cylinder_target.name: queer_cylinder_target
queer_cylinder_target.qfep_connection: a target that takes the hit and keeps its difference — the cylinder the throwing room aims at; consequence's address.

quest_controller.description: Procedural Quest Touch controller model for tutorials. Use #highlight:trigger/grip/thumbstick/button_a/button_b/menu and #right:true/false
quest_controller.name: Quest Controller

random_object_spawner.description: A spawning algorithm that randomly generates and places objects in the environment
random_object_spawner.name: Random Object Spawner

reality_modifier.description: Tool for modifying the fundamental nature of reality
reality_modifier.name: Reality Modifier

rectcube.description: Flat rectangular cube platform (1.0 x 0.2 x 1.0)
rectcube.name: Rectangular Cube

righttriangle.capacity: READ which properties survive rotation and translation because the right angle stays invariant.
righttriangle.description: A right triangle presented as a clean spatial reference. Translation and rotation can move it anywhere, but the ninety-degree relation remains the defining invariant. That makes it useful for reading orientation, perpendicularity, and angular preservation against more complex scenes. It keeps the idea of the right angle available as a diagnostic form.
interactions: place the triangle beside rotating geometry as a reference
compare its hypotenuse and legs under different orientations
use it to read perpendicular relationships in the room
inspect how a thin 2D form behaves inside 3D space
righttriangle.name: righttriangle
righttriangle.qfep_connection: Transformation changes position and orientation while the right angle stays invariant. The artifact isolates what geometric identity survives motion.

rock_scanner.description: Dimensional scanner - reveals 2D cross-sections of 3D irregular forms, showing how dimensionality affects perception
rock_scanner.name: Rock Scanner

rock_spawner.description: Spawns multiple irregular rocks with physics - demonstrates packing inefficiency and gaps
rock_spawner.name: Rock Spawner

rockfactory.description: Generates collections of irregular procedural rocks to demonstrate gaps and packing. Supports multiple spawn modes (box, pile, grid, ring, cluster) and optional gravity.
rockfactory.name: Rock Factory

rockfactory_gravity.description: Rock factory pre-configured with gravity enabled - spawns rocks that fall and settle into containers, demonstrating natural packing and gaps between irregular forms.
rockfactory_gravity.name: Rock Factory (Gravity)

rotating_cube.description: A mysterious rotating cube that triggers the first learning sequence
rotating_cube.name: Rotating Cube
rotating_cube.qfep_connection: oscillation: a cube in steady rotation — the room's metronome; period made visible.

rotation_match_puzzle.description: Vera MolnÃ¡r-inspired rotation puzzle. Match cube rotations to ghost targets. Config: style:molnar|interruptions|random|gradient, grid_x:3, grid_z:3, max_rot:45, tolerance:10, axis:z
rotation_match_puzzle.name: Rotation Match Puzzle

roughrock.description: Irregular rock polyhedron created from noise-perturbed vertices.
roughrock.name: roughrock
roughrock.qfep_connection: A rock made by roughing up a polyhedron — vertices pushed out by noise until the clean solid becomes stone. The primitive meeting the randomness chapter early: proof that the organic is just the geometric with its corners disturbed, and that nature's shapes are ideal ones under perturbation.

scale_lines.description: [100m, 10m, 1m, 10cm, 1mm] — a logarithmic ladder of reference lengths made tangible
scale_lines.name: scale_lines
scale_lines.qfep_connection: A logarithmic ladder made tangible — 100m, 10m, 1m, 10cm, 1mm — the reference lengths that give every other measurement meaning. The primitive of scale itself: before a size can be read, a ruler of sizes must exist, and this exhibit is the chapter admitting that even measurement needs its own furniture.

scifi_panel_wall.description: A futuristic panel wall with procedural greebles and atmospheric lighting
scifi_panel_wall.name: Sci-Fi Panel Wall

simple_rock.description: Simple irregular rock made from wiggled low-poly sphere - falls with physics
simple_rock.name: Simple Dynamic Rock

sliding_door.description: Door that slides left/right on X axis. Teaches translation along a single axis with visual rail and position marker.
sliding_door.name: Sliding Door

small_subdivision_cube.name: small_subdivision_cube
small_subdivision_cube.qfep_connection: Subdivision at hand scale: a cube split into its own smaller selves, the volume version of the Koch move — one artifact you can circle that holds the whole idea of scale recursion.

snap_octahedron_puzzle.description: Interactive puzzle where connecting 6 snap points forms an octahedron that spawns a walkable prism.
snap_octahedron_puzzle.name: Snap Octahedron Puzzle
snap_octahedron_puzzle.qfep_connection: Connect six snap points and an octahedron assembles — then becomes a walkable prism. The dual of the cube built by hand: the puzzle stages the chapter's ascent from points to solids to *places*, and rewards a correct construction with a room you can enter. Geometry earning habitability, six vertices at a time.

snap_pyramid_puzzle.description: Interactive puzzle where connecting 5 snap points forms a square pyramid that spawns a walkable prism.
snap_pyramid_puzzle.name: Snap Pyramid Puzzle
snap_pyramid_puzzle.qfep_connection: Connect five snap points and a square pyramid assembles itself — then becomes a walkable space. The chapter's deepest trick in one gesture: build the primitive correctly and it stops being an object and becomes a *place* you can enter. Geometry earning habitability.

snap_tetrahedron_puzzle.description: Interactive puzzle where connecting 4 snap points forms a tetrahedron that spawns a cube.
snap_tetrahedron_puzzle.name: Snap Tetrahedron Puzzle
snap_tetrahedron_puzzle.qfep_connection: Four snap points, and a tetrahedron forms — which then spawns a cube. The minimal solid conjuring the familiar one: the puzzle stages the chapter's whole ascent, from the simplest possible volume to the one everything in this grid is made of.

snap_triangle_puzzle.description: Interactive puzzle where connecting 3 snap points forms a triangle that spawns a configurable object.
snap_triangle_puzzle.name: Snap Triangle Puzzle

snap_wedge_puzzle.description: Interactive puzzle where connecting 6 snap points forms a wedge/prism that spawns a walkable ramp.
snap_wedge_puzzle.name: Snap Wedge Puzzle

sphere.description: Standard grid-shaded sphere primitive for basic geometry demonstrations.
sphere.name: sphere
sphere.qfep_connection: The sphere, plainly — the primitive of perfect roundness, every point equidistant from a center. The shape antiquity thought the heavens were made of, standing here grid-shaded and ordinary, the baseline against which the low/mid/high tessellations measure how much smoothness costs.

sphere_high.description: High poly sphere with 32 rings and 32 radial segments for smooth appearance.
sphere_high.name: sphere_high
sphere_high.qfep_connection: The sphere at 32 rings and segments — smooth to the eye, the illusion complete. Set beside its low-poly siblings it makes the chapter's quiet point about representation: the curve was never real, only approached, and 'smooth' is just 'faceted' with the facets small enough to forgive.

sphere_low.description: Low poly sphere with 8 rings and 8 radial segments showing tessellation structure.
sphere_low.name: sphere_low
sphere_low.qfep_connection: The sphere at 8 rings — faceted, blunt, honest about its lie. The low-poly exhibit that shows what a sphere really is underneath: not a curve but a *decision* about how many flat triangles will stand in for one, curvature confessed as an illusion held by enough small planes.

sphere_mid.description: Medium poly sphere with 16 rings and 16 radial segments for balanced detail.
sphere_mid.name: sphere_mid
sphere_mid.qfep_connection: The sphere at 16 segments — the balanced compromise, smooth enough to read as round, coarse enough to still see the seams. The middle term of the tessellation lesson: every smooth surface in this world is a budget, and this is what a reasonable budget buys.

square_pyramid.description: Johnson Solid J1: Square pyramid with 4 triangular faces and 1 square base.
square_pyramid.name: square_pyramid

star_primitive.name: Star
star_primitive.qfep_connection: A five-pointed star given thickness — the primitive of the emblem, the shape that means before it measures. The one exhibit here whose geometry is mostly semantic: five points, a pentagram's ghost, proof that even the alphabet of pure form carries meanings it did not ask for.

static_point.description: Non-pickable point marker that displays position. Cannot be grabbed by hands or captured by gravity gun.
static_point.name: Static Point

tetrahedron.description: Procedural tetrahedron mesh rendered with the project grid material.
tetrahedron.name: tetrahedron

tetrahedron_edit.description: Tetrahedron with draggable vertex handles. 4 vertices, 4 faces.
tetrahedron_edit.name: Editable Tetrahedron

torus.description: Grid material torus primitive for layout and shading tests.
torus.name: torus

torus_low.description: Low poly torus with 8 ring segments and 6 radial segments showing donut structure.
torus_low.name: torus_low

torus_radials_rings.description: Configurable torus with rings and ring segments. Usage: torus_radials_rings:90:1:#inner:0.2#outer:0.6 or #config:16:8 for 16 rings and 8 ring segments.
torus_radials_rings.name: Torus Radials Rings
torus_radials_rings.qfep_connection: The torus with its resolution exposed — rings around the tube, segments around the ring, both adjustable. The donut as a lesson in double curvature: the only primitive here you cannot flatten without tearing, and the dials show it being built the only way it can be, one quad ring stacked around another.

trafficcone.description: Orange traffic cone with white stripes and square base. Construction site safety marker.
trafficcone.name: Traffic Cone

transform_staircase_dna.description: DNA double helix: two interleaved spirals. Array + rotation + phase offset.
transform_staircase_dna.name: transform_staircase_dna
transform_staircase_dna.qfep_connection: The double helix is a spiral staircase plus its phase-shifted twin: same array, same rotation-per-step, offset half a turn. Heredity's most sacred icon reduces to one loop read twice at different phases.

transform_staircase_fibonacci.description: Fibonacci spiral: array + golden angle (137.5Â°) + scaling. Nature's growth pattern.
transform_staircase_fibonacci.name: transform_staircase_fibonacci

transform_staircase_mobius.description: MÃ¶bius strip: array + rotation + twist. One-sided surface, topological oddity.
transform_staircase_mobius.name: transform_staircase_mobius

transform_staircase_showcase.description: All five staircase types together: Linear, Spiral, DNA, Fibonacci, MÃ¶bius. Culmination of arrays + transformation.
transform_staircase_showcase.name: transform_staircase_showcase
transform_staircase_showcase.qfep_connection: Five silhouettes, one script: linear, spiral, DNA, Fibonacci and Möbius are the same loop over step_count with a different transform composed per index, distinguished by nothing but an enum value. Family resemblance made literal — variation as a switch statement over repetition.

transform_staircase_spiral.description: Spiral staircase: array + rotation + translation. Rainbow helix ascending through space.
transform_staircase_spiral.name: transform_staircase_spiral

transformation_cube.description: A mysterious rotating cube that triggers the first learning sequence
transformation_cube.name: transformation_cube
transformation_cube.qfep_connection: a cube cycling its transforms — the transformation family's ambassador in the wave rooms.

translation_demo.description: Two blocking obstacles demonstrating X and Y axis translation. Red obstacle slides horizontally, blue obstacle slides vertically. Obstacles turn green when path is cleared.
translation_demo.name: Translation Demo

triangle.description: Interactive triangle mesh with draggable vertices and presets for equilateral, right-angled, and isosceles shapes.
triangle.name: triangle
triangle.qfep_connection: Three points, and suddenly there is an *inside*: the first shape that encloses, the minimum fence. Drag its vertices through equilateral, right, and scalene and feel identity survive deformation — the triangle is where position becomes area, and the plane gets its atom.

parasol_triangle.description: A triangle mounted on a thin stick like a parasol. Double-sided (pink front, blue back) to show orientation. Place multiples for a forest of triangle flags.
parasol_triangle.name: Parasol Triangle
parasol_triangle.qfep_connection: A triangle on a stick, pink front and blue back, held up like a parasol so you can catch it lying. The double-sided honesty of a face: which way it points is not decoration but data, the primitive teaching that a surface has an opinion about front and back.

triangle_line_puzzle.description: Interactive puzzle: drag 3 line endpoints to form an equilateral triangle.
triangle_line_puzzle.name: Triangle Line Puzzle
triangle_line_puzzle.qfep_connection: Drag three endpoints until the sides are equal — an equilateral triangle, discovered rather than drawn. The puzzle where the hand meets the plane's first enclosure and learns that 'equilateral' is a *condition* satisfied, three lengths agreeing, the simplest fairness a shape can hold.

triangleprofiles.description: Folded pink zigzag profile built from alternating peaks with drag points to edit the pleated surface.
triangleprofiles.name: 1.2: A triangleprofilese
triangleprofiles.qfep_connection: A pleated pink zigzag — alternating peaks folded into a profile you can edit by dragging. The primitive of the fold shown as a section: how a flat strip, creased in a rhythm, becomes a surface with strength and shadow. The chapter's handshake with form-finding and origami, one ribbon deep.

triangular_cupola.description: Johnson Solid J3: Triangular cupola combining triangular and square faces.
triangular_cupola.name: triangular_cupola

triangularblock.description: Triangular block mesh with matched convex collision for kitbashing.
triangularblock.name: triangularblock

truncatedtetrahedron.description: tetrahedron with corners cut — each vertex replaced by a triangular face, adding 4 new faces
truncatedtetrahedron.name: truncatedtetrahedron
truncatedtetrahedron.qfep_connection: A tetrahedron with its corners cut — each vertex replaced by a triangular face, the simplest Archimedean solid. The primitive that shows how truncation makes a new regular form from an old one: slice the points off the minimal solid and thirteen semi-regular cousins become possible. Geometry reproducing by amputation, the Platonic set giving birth to the Archimedean.

unitcube.description: Unit cube from vertex and face arrays
unitcube.name: Unit Cube

zigzagprofile.description: Interactive zigzag strip featuring top and base grab points plus presets for zigzag, sine, and sawtooth patterns.
zigzagprofile.name: 1.2: A zigzagprofile

achilles_tortoise.description: Zeno's paradox of Achilles and the Tortoise. Watch infinite steps converge to a finite limit: A_n = L*(1-1/2^n). Each step halves the gap — infinite steps, finite distance. The paradox dissolves in the limit.
achilles_tortoise.name: Achilles and the Tortoise
achilles_tortoise.qfep_connection: Zeno's race staged as steps that shrink toward a limit — Achilles gaining forever and arriving anyway. The paradox that made mathematicians distrust infinity for two thousand years, standing in the primitives room as a warning: the simplest setup, a runner and a lead, contains a crack that took calculus to seal.

mesh_builder_demo.name: Mesh Builder Demo
mesh_builder_demo.description: Interactive mesh construction from primitives. Add vertices as spheres, connect them with edges, fill triangles as colored faces. Shows how meshes are built from points, lines, and faces.

klee_walking_point.description: A luminous point that sets itself in motion and leaves a trail of points - the trail IS a line. Klee's Pedagogical Sketchbook page one: an active line on a walk. walk_style: 'meander' (queer wander) vs 'straight' (collapsed shortest path).
klee_walking_point.name: Klee Walking Point
klee_walking_point.qfep_connection: A line is a point that refused to stay still. The straight walk learned nothing; the meander is the line at the edge of chaos.

fontana_puncture.description: A solid cube with an oversized sphere subtracted (CSG, baked) so the void breaches every face - Fontana's Concetto Spaziale in 3D. A luminous point floats at the centre.
fontana_puncture.name: Fontana Puncture
fontana_puncture.qfep_connection: The point given a radius and aimed at solid matter becomes the absence that defines the form. Subtraction as meaning - the first boolean.

you_are_here.description: A text decal on the floor - YOU ARE HERE lying flat underfoot, the wayfinding locator. A flat indexical inscription you stand ON. TextMesh. pride_gradient reclaims the corporate blue dot.
you_are_here.name: You Are Here
you_are_here.qfep_connection: 'You are here' is what a civilisation writes when it renders every body as a coordinate it has already labelled. The friendliest face of algorithmic capture.

mystic_writing_pad.description: Freud's Mystic Writing-Pad (Wunderblock, 1925) as the trace apparatus: a red-framed magic slate where a stylus writes a bright trace of points on a clearing sheet, and every lift sinks the trace into the wax below as a faint warm ghost. The surface forgets; the depth remembers. Derrida's model of the trace, made a thing you stand before.
mystic_writing_pad.name: Mystic Writing Pad
mystic_writing_pad.qfep_connection: The Mystic Pad lies the way every memory system lies: it shows a clean surface and keeps the wax. 'Clear' is the politest word a machine knows for 'kept, where you can no longer see it' - the trace as the friendly face, and the log, of algorithmic memory.

hand_telemetry_display.description: A big dark Half-Life-2 / Combine-style ops monitor on a grey pipe-clamp arm, streaming the player's RIGHT HAND world position in real time: large orange X/Y/Z numerals plus a scrolling timecoded coordinate log, newest bright and fading down. The point that is watched. Falls back to a demo drift when no XR hand is present.
hand_telemetry_display.name: Hand Telemetry Display
hand_telemetry_display.qfep_connection: The display helps you and records you in the same orange glow: 'you are at (0.42, 1.13, -0.88)' means 'we have you at (0.42, 1.13, -0.88), and at every value before it.' The friendliest face of capture is a monitor that calls surveillance a service.

living_paper.description: A hanging sheet of warm paper that is alive: it breathes (a standing-wave ripple) and reads the player's RIGHT HAND into itself - the paper bulges toward the nearby hand like skin under a touch and blooms a fading ink trace of dots where it passes. The warm counterpart to the telemetry monitor: the trace received, not logged. Phantom-hand fallback for capture.
living_paper.name: Living Paper
living_paper.qfep_connection: The paper that leans toward you and inks your wandering is the tenderest face of the same act the monitor performs coldly: it receives you, keeps a little of you, and it is hard to say where care ends and capture begins - which is exactly the trace.

hand_telemetry_diptych.description: Two Half-Life-2 / Combine-style ops monitors side by side on one grey pipe-clamp mount - a diptych. The LEFT panel (cyan) streams the left hand's live world position, the RIGHT panel (orange) the right hand's, each a scrolling coordinate log. The tracked body split down the middle and read in stereo. Composes two hand_telemetry_display panels.
hand_telemetry_diptych.name: Hand Telemetry Diptych
hand_telemetry_diptych.qfep_connection: You were never watched as a whole, only as a set of hands, each on its own bright channel. The diptych is honest about the plural: a fully captured body is just a list of points, one feed per part.

automatic_writing_desk.description: A desk with a sheet of paper that the headset writes by itself: a pen sweeps left-to-right and drops a row at the margin, filling the page top-to-bottom with asemic script whose jaggedness scales with HEAD speed (still = flat ruled line, moving = jagged handwriting). Surrealist automatic writing / the spiritualist planchette, with the head as the medium. Driven by XRCamera3D; demo head-drift fallback.
automatic_writing_desk.name: Automatic Writing Desk
automatic_writing_desk.qfep_connection: The desk transcribes the one thing you never agreed to author: your attention. A head, sampled as it turns toward whatever it cannot help looking at, is a confession written in a hand you can't read - kept on the page after you walk away.

two_points_line.description: Two luminous endpoints and the segment between them - Euclid's first postulate. Different-coloured points with a messenger travelling A<->B so the line reads as a live channel of relation.
two_points_line.name: Two Points Line
two_points_line.qfep_connection: A line is the first relation in geometry - relation, not substance. Collapse is A=B; the move is difference held apart and bridged without being erased.

horizon_line.description: A horizon - sky over ground meeting at a bright seam that overhangs the frame. Friedrich, Rothko, Munoz's queer horizon: the line as the not-yet, approached and never reached.
horizon_line.name: Horizon Line
horizon_line.qfep_connection: Futurity installed as a primitive: the only line whose definition includes your never reaching it. Munoz's world that is not enough yet.

redline.description: A red line on the floor with two faintly different fields either side - the line that divides. HOLC redlining (1935), the analog ancestor of the classifier's decision boundary. Steppable, which the originals were not.
redline.name: Redline
redline.qfep_connection: The same primitive that connects can sort - sorting, drawn and enforced, is the ancestor of every algorithmic fence. The decision boundary with its map returned.

three_points_triangle.description: Three points, three edges, the moment they close into a surface - the first plane, the GPU's atom. Corner points, edges, a real filled face, the face normal. Everything smooth is secretly faceted.
three_points_triangle.name: Three Points Triangle
three_points_triangle.qfep_connection: Point->line->triangle is the curriculum's first complete sentence: a position, a relation, an enclosed inside. The founding act of all computer graphics.

tensegrity_triangle.description: A triangle of three struts and three joints holding its shape under a load that would fold any other polygon. Fuller: the triangle is the only rigid polygon. A compression pulse it visibly springs back from.
tensegrity_triangle.name: Tensegrity Triangle
tensegrity_triangle.qfep_connection: The triangle as relation made rigid - the first structure that holds itself up. Nature stabilises with triangles because nothing else stays true under load.

pink_triangle.description: A pink triangle on black - the Nazi camp badge turned point-UP by Silence=Death and ACT UP, a banner of refusal. Its orientation is the whole argument. inverted=false is the reclaimed form.
pink_triangle.name: Pink Triangle
pink_triangle.qfep_connection: Queerness coded into the most elementary form - a hinge to the QFEP thesis. Form is never neutral once a body has worn it; the reclaiming 180 degrees is the move made history.

triangle_whiteboard.description: A lab whiteboard with the science of the triangle in marker (TextMesh) - diagram, angle sum, rigidity, the GPU fact. The first scientific-register board (later superseded by the hand-chalk chalkboard).
triangle_whiteboard.name: Triangle Whiteboard
triangle_whiteboard.qfep_connection: The scientific register - the flat truth behind the poetry. A curriculum needs a surface where the answer is written.

chalkboard.description: A framed blackboard with hand-chalked notation in Turing's hand - a ScribbleControl draws real math as wobbly chalk strokes (no font), mapped onto a 3D board. Default: the triangle facts. Content is the lines array.
chalkboard.name: Chalkboard
chalkboard.qfep_connection: A queer-humanist curriculum needs the answer written by a HAND, not typeset by a machine that pretends mathematics fell from the sky. Even 180 degrees was thought by somebody, at a board.

wall_placard.description: A museum wall caption — TITLE, a thin accent rule, sequence-date metadata, and one sentence of intent, in gallery-label typography. The curatorial register of the lab: it CAPTIONS the work (where the chalkboard states the science and the gem enacts it). Replaces the old AnnotationInfoBoard HUD (XP/health/barcode) as the wall caption. Procedural 2D-in-3D, baked to a mipmapped texture so the small body text stays legible at VR distance.
wall_placard.name: Wall Placard

parameters.title: THE POINT
parameters.body: Position without extension. Zero dimensions. The seed of all form.

wall_placard.qfep_connection: Curation is a choice about what is made thinkable; the label decides the one sentence the visitor carries.

point_chalkboard.description: A chalkboard for THE POINT - a chalk dot with crosshair guides: P=(x,y,z), 0 dimensions, the seed of all form.
point_chalkboard.name: Point Chalkboard
point_chalkboard.qfep_connection: Even 'nothing' has a definition - the dimensionless seed every shape grows from.

triangle_chalkboard.description: A mystical chalkboard for THE TRIANGLE - the labelled triangle plus Δ as both shape and symbol: the first plane to close, the only rigid polygon, and change/difference. Ends on a koan, not a formula: 'what is the cost of Δ?'
triangle_chalkboard.name: Triangle Chalkboard
triangle_chalkboard.qfep_connection: Δ is form, change, and difference in one symbol - and to differ, to close a new plane, is never free. The board names the cost without paying it.

line_chalkboard.description: A chalkboard for THE LINE - endpoints A,B and midpoint M: shortest path, length |B-A|, M=(A+B)/2, 1 dimension.
line_chalkboard.name: Line Chalkboard
line_chalkboard.qfep_connection: The line as pure relation - two points imply a unique straight path. The first relation, stated by hand.

quad_chalkboard.description: A chalkboard for THE QUAD - a rectangle with the diagonal: 4 vertices, area w*h, GPU draws 2 triangles, the screen is a quad.
quad_chalkboard.name: Quad Chalkboard
quad_chalkboard.qfep_connection: Every screen is two triangles pretending to be a rectangle. The triangle never left.

qfep_chalkboard.description: A wide chalkboard for the QUEER FREE ENERGY PRINCIPLE - QFE = F - lambda E(S) + phi dE beside an edge-of-chaos curve peaking at lambda~0.4 where life sits between order and noise.
qfep_chalkboard.name: QFEP Chalkboard
qfep_chalkboard.qfep_connection: This IS the QFEP, stated. Life at the edge, not frozen and not noise. The phi-term is the queer one - refusing to settle.

endlessness_chalkboard.description: A chalkboard for ENDLESSNESS - potential vs actual infinity, an inward spiral that never closes. The limit approached but never reached.
endlessness_chalkboard.name: Endlessness Chalkboard
endlessness_chalkboard.qfep_connection: Two infinities: a process with no last step, and the completed whole. Reaching the limit would end the endlessness.

thrownness_chalkboard.description: A chalkboard for THROWNNESS - Heidegger's Geworfenheit: a figure dropped along an arrow into a bounded grid it did not choose. Made literal: spawn is a throw.
thrownness_chalkboard.name: Thrownness Chalkboard
thrownness_chalkboard.qfep_connection: You wake already IN a world, at a place not of your choosing. The grid was here before you. You are here - and here was not your decision.

network_chalkboard.description: A chalkboard for the primitives principle 'Lines, Networks, Measure', hand-chalked on the scribble engine: a network diagram beside the principle's facts. The scientific register of the primitives sequence.
network_chalkboard.name: Network Chalkboard
network_chalkboard.qfep_connection: The principle 'Lines, Networks, Measure' stated by a hand, not typeset - chalk insisting an elementary fact was thought by somebody, in a body, at a board.

silhouette_gate.name: Silhouette Gate (draw to open)
silhouette_gate.description: A ghost silhouette of a form. Take the drawing point and trace the form by passing through every vertex; complete it and the form dissolves as a sliding door opens. 2D forms (triangle, square/quad, pentagon, hexagon, circle) AND 3D forms — a cube is a green wireframe whose 8 corners must all be drawn through. Configurable: form, form_size, hit_radius, ordered, ring_points, rotation_offset_deg, door_tag.

archimedean_tunnel.description: The primitives seam. A digital line is a polygon pretending to be a curve — at arm's length the machine's chords read smooth; magnified (the tunnel) they cut every corner, with holes between the samples where the hand was and the machine never looked. Archimedes exhausted the circle with polygons; the machine stops at N.
archimedean_tunnel.name: Archimedean Tunnel
archimedean_tunnel.qfep_connection: A station in the bias landscape (doc/SEAM_PER_SEQUENCE.md); the digital-bias seam for primitives. Bias is conserved; show the seam.

rotating_prisme.name: Rotating Prisme
rotating_prisme.description: A slowly rotating prism — continuous rotation makes orientation legible without interaction. Sibling of prism_block; used in the 2D-colour tutorial as ambient motion reference.
